inReplyTo.description: Message-ID header of the mail being replied to.

messageId.description: Client-supplied mail ID for correlation and duplicate detection.

priority.description: Mail priority, written to the X-Priority header.

scheduleTime.description: Scheduled send time as 'date HH:mm:ss'; date is dd/MM/yyyy if the user's date format is dd/MM/yy or dd/MM/yyyy, else MM/dd/yyyy (e.g. 20/09/2026 10:30:00). Required when isSchedule is true and scheduleType omitted.

scheduleTimeLong.description: Scheduled send time in epoch milliseconds.

scheduleType.description: Predefined schedule interval. Required when isSchedule is true and scheduleTime omitted.

sendViaQueue.description: With a custom SMTP server, queue and send offline.

timeZone.description: Time zone of scheduled send time. Required when isSchedule is true.
